def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    col=max(set(sum(g,[]))-{0})
    for i in range(H):

                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
